title: Magazine p. 60: Debris around Saturn booster after Apollo separation (NASA AS17-148-22687)
description: Photocopied magazine page dominated by a photograph (numbered 35) showing a round frame containing the Saturn booster stage amid scattered debris. The caption reads "Clouds of debris surround the Saturn booster rocket following Apollo separation. Blow-up photos of individual pieces of debris inside and outside the cabin have been called 'UFOs'. NASA photo AS17-148-22687." Article text below discusses quotations attributed to astronaut John Young about UFOs.
